description: This Java class 'ExternalEventsExtension' is a JUnit extension that manages external event configurations during test execution. It initializes REST API settings, captures the state before tests, and restores any changes after tests to maintain test isolation.

classes.name: ExternalEventsExtension
classes.description: A JUnit 5 extension that captures and restores external event configurations to ensure test isolation.

methods.name: ExternalEventsExtension
methods.description: Constructor that initializes REST API specifications, sets default headers, and prepares the extension.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Restores external event configurations to their original state after each test.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Captures the current external event configurations before each test.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Helper method to update a specific external event configuration back to its original value.
